powers.name: Pyrotechnics

powers.text: 1 charge: it shoots a harmless burst of colorful light. (No other effect in the game.)

summary: 7 charges: it shoots a harmless burst of colorful light.
text: This wand has 7 charges. While holding it, you can expend 1 charge as a Magic action: it shoots a harmless burst of colorful light. The wand regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the last charge, roll 1d20; on a 1 the wand crumbles to dust. (No other effect in the game.)
